headline: SPCX: no trade. Real merger process, but no terms, so no direction; earnings already +4%
reasoning: SpaceX Q3: revenue $14.6B (+161%), net income $4.4B. IEX had SPCX +4.2% by 16:55 ET.
Musk confirmed on the webcast that SpaceX and Tesla have independent special committees evaluating a merger; neither company has filed anything.
ANALYST stopped it: with Tesla the larger party and no exchange ratio, SPCX's side of the deal has no sign.
Data limit found tonight: IEX after-hours ends at 17:00 ET, so news after 5pm shows no price reaction in our feed.
Watch: an 8-K from either company with a merger agreement would be a fresh, primary-source case.
objections: The merger rests on webcast remarks only: no filing from either company, no terms, no exchange ratio.
Direction is undefined until an exchange ratio exists; the earnings reaction is already in the price.
